parsed.rationale: The second participating record, `MockNotificationMessage` in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift`, carries `is_test: true`. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a test-marked record must be treated as a test-fixture and no refactor action taken. Introducing a shared parent protocol between `AsyncNotificationMessage` (production) and `MockNotificationMessage` (test) would couple production semantics to test infrastructure.
